title: UI Branch Status
description: Computed: a branch's chain to its root, its changed items and conflicts the requesting user may read, and the URL of a type's list on it. Read-only.

branch.description: The branch, as its URL names it (a name, optionally @pinned).

chain.description: The branch, then its ancestors, nearest first.

prefix.description: A published branch's prefix; null for a working branch.

changed.description: The branch's own rows (overrides, additions, deletion markers) the user may read; none on main.

conflicts.description: The conflicts on own rows the user may read: those a pull listed (parent), then those with a packaged layer (layer).

browse_url.description: With ?type=<slug>: that type's list on the branch, under its published root's prefix; else null.
